body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 593f400c90fab3ba3d80dd9d032fab0f940b11aa -->
Needs changes before merge.

The Manual group uses the existing form helpers. The preview reads the draft. The edit still uses the existing command. This PR does not change posted G-code, collision checks, gouge checks, stock simulation, or machining geometry. No golden files changed. Safety-tier mutations were not required and were not run.

Local results, after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at e2f012e90c3174fb308344e5122bb39e70531d90:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from crates/ui: 784 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored. The three new Slot tests passed.
- The failed test was `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`. A separate run failed for the same reason. This machine has no graphics adapter. This is an environment limit, not a code finding.
- UI integration suites: boundary 3, boundary_picks 6, edge_loop_pick 3, feedback 6, machine 6, operations 31, sinker_setup 1, theme_files 14. All 70 tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The quick gate plan was read with `--dry-run`; the full quick gate was not run. No GitHub runner was used.

Graphics test error:
```text
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
metal found no adapters
```

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/slot_manual_viz.rs:46`: Check that the Properties pane shows this operation before you return its draft points. To see the problem, open a Slot on Geometry, then open a tool or setup page. `State::sync_ops_ui` keeps the old `op_ui` when the target is not an operation (state.rs:2290). This guard still passes, and shell.rs draws the old Slot marks on the other page. Also hide the marks when Properties is closed or hidden. Add tests for these transitions.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_more_page.rs:54`: Add before and after screenshots to the PR body for the Manual section and the viewport marks. Issue #1732 requires them. The body says they were skipped. The structural tests do not replace this requirement.

Note: shell.rs grows from 1023 to 1030 lines. Move overlay drawing to a separate module when this area is next changed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

At the final state check, GitHub reports CONFLICTING. The local trial merge above passed against the recorded main commit. Refresh the branch at merge time under the repository rules.

Finding 1 is fixed in 8c17efb95672c98d869f13b2c04a64cda72233c2. Slot marks now require visible Properties targeting the same operation.

Pins:
- `no_marks_after_switching_to_a_tool_or_setup_page` covers retained drafts on tool and setup pages.
- `no_marks_when_properties_is_closed_or_hidden` covers the visibility guards.
- `shell_updates_slot_marks_when_properties_is_hidden_and_closed` covers actual dock transitions.

All six Slot tests pass. Removing each of the target, closed, hidden, and shell-wiring checks caused RED. Restoring each caused GREEN.

Finding 2 remains open. Real before and after screenshots could not be captured. Metal exposes no graphics adapter in this environment. The PR body now records that obstacle and the remaining requirement.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is RED only on `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` and `headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero`. Both report no graphics adapter. UI clippy with all targets and warnings denied passes.

Please re-review the new head. The PR remains a draft.
This PR was closed when its base PR #1745 merged. The work continues in PR #2034 (same branch, merged with main, finding 1 fixed, screenshots rendered). Review there.
